scope: 8-K exhibits (#322): real material agreements of the theme companies, read with the exhibits switch on and scored on their own, apart from the frozen main set. Each exhibit is read or skipped by the production rules (exhibits.decide on the Item 9.01 description, the 30,000 token limit for unclear ones). Known: the supplier / customer the agreement states between the filer and its counterparty. Redacted values ([*], [***], [ ]) are never numbers: a share on these links is a wrong number. Leases of data-centre space are optional, as in the main set. The credit agreement is a trap: skipped as financing, and its lenders must not become links.
